opening.argument: The presentation explains a rewards offer: downloading apps earns credits that can be redeemed for gift cards and subscriptions. It also describes keeping an app open for 30 seconds to receive credits and referring friends to earn more. A device-enrollment step and an Install Profile prompt are shown, but the available evidence does not establish which settings would change, whether the profile was installed, or whether rewards were delivered. The referral instructions and Subscribe graphic appear as engagement or credit-earning features; neither establishes a subscription requirement or a connection to payment, credential requests, loss, or a completed transaction.
